title: Anchored Hilbert Cube reconnaissance
a1_4_scope: Bounded rational-point closure attempt for the exact equation-(6) anchor tower only: Weierstrass/descent information for the genus-1 quotient, then z^2-4 square, k square, and u^2+4 square reconstruction tests.
hard_stop_condition: If A1-4 does not close or materially shrink the exact rational-point tower after a bounded direct attempt, or if the route remains only a family-specific exclusion without a new reverse-map/coverage theorem, terminate StageA1 rather than creating a refinement chain.
substantive_progress_requires_one_of: new proved identity or rational-point statement
removal of a genuine anchor-boundary component
strictly enlarged proved coverage of anchored cubes
new necessary condition for arbitrary anchored cubes
exact adapter to an already-proved theorem
firewalls: No family-specific exclusion implies perfect-cuboid nonexistence.
Equation (6) is not assumed universal; A1-3 proves its anchor boundary has dimension at most one while the full anchored algebraic variety has components of dimension at least two.
A rational point on the elliptic quotient is necessary but not sufficient; every reconstruction square-cover and nondegeneracy condition must pass.
Stage27 and StructureRadar receivers remain unchanged.
Numerical evidence is diagnostic unless converted to a proof.
No unrelated literature rotation or endless refinement after the bounded A1-4 attempt.
